{{Top|leg}}
An '''Inert-screen load shifter''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] in engineering facilities and interstellar shipyards to transport quanitites of lethal fissionable material. It's basic design consisted of a large shielded container, with a simple electronic brain, mounted on a pair of short stubby legs.

Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], in an ill-conceived attempt to implicate the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] in the deaths of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|aunt]] and [[Owen Lars/Legends|uncle]], the [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]] placed a highly-modified inert-screen load shifter near the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. This droid contained surveillance equipment to record the tragic event and a false recording of Xizor's pheromones to link him to the murders. This droid eventually fell into the hands of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]].
